name: Torii
author: E. T. Carter
description: A processional avenue of gates running dead away from the eye: a single torii SDF (two round pillars, a long gently curved lintel, a lower tie-beam) repeated down the view axis by domain mod, each instance hash-leaned and hash-scaled a few percent off true. Dozens nest in one-point perspective, the nearest a huge near-black frame and the farthest dissolving into fog; the underside of every lintel catches a faint warm lantern rim while a thin ankle mist breathes between the pillars. The camera dollies forward forever down the centerline - only the eye moves.

params.label: Dolly speed
params.effect: How fast the camera advances down the avenue of gates.

params.label: Gate spacing
params.effect: World distance between successive gates - close packs them into a dense tunnel, far strings them out as lone arches.

params.label: Lantern glow
params.effect: Warmth of the faint light caught under each lintel and along the ankle mist.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: How many gates remain visible before the avenue dissolves into haze.
